description:
VitalSpace is a multidisciplinary team of students from Paysandú dedicated to safeguarding the health of space explorers. We combine software and science to build a self-assessment tool that enables astronauts to track their health metrics, interpret them, and take timely action when help is far away. We believe that going further requires taking care of those who make it possible.

Our logo represents the constellation Ophiuchus, associated with Asclepius, the god of medicine.
